about: Every release commits the graph the build wrote, data/grc-graph.json. For each release whose graph differs from the release before, data/grc-history.json keeps what changed: the nodes and edges added and removed, the edges whose basis changed (inferred to confirmed, say), and the gaps opened and closed. The gaps are computed with today's rules (data/grc-gaps.json) over each release's graph, so two releases are always compared by the same yardstick. Any two releases can then be compared by replaying the changes between them, which the page does in the reader's browser.
